review_comment: The password reset function retrieves users by email input and resets passwords without demonstrating email ownership verification. While form validation is present, ensure the ResetForm includes proper email verification (such as sending confirmation links or requiring current password) before allowing password changes. Implement email confirmation with time-limited tokens to verify the user controls the email address before resetting passwords.
